* 1920 : It started as Gahagan Paints & Varnish Co. Ltd. grew popular as Goodlass Nerolac Paints (Pvt.) Ltd. Also, it went public in the same year and established itself as Goodlass Nerolac Paints Ltd. . * 1976 : Goodlass Nerolac Paints Ltd. became a part of [[Tata Group|Tata]] [[Forbes (engineering company)|Forbes]] Group on acquisition of a part of the foreign shareholdings by [[Forbes]] Gokak. . * 1983 : Goodlass Nerolac Paints Ltd. strengthened itself by entering in technical collaboration agreement by [[Kansai Paint]] Co. Ltd., Japan and Nihon Tokushu Tokyo Co. Ltd., Japan. * 1999 : Kansai Paint Co. Ltd. , Japan took over the entire stake of Tata Forbes group and thus Goodlass Nerolac Paints became wholly owned subsidiary of Kansai Paint Company Ltd.{{cite web |url=http://bullscrip.com/kansai-nerolac-ltd-a-paint-for-your-portfolio-to-color/ |title=Kansai Nerolac LTD: A paint for your portfolio to color | Bulls Scrip |access-date=15 June 2013 |archive-url=https://archive.today/20130616021735/http://bullscrip.com/kansai-nerolac-ltd-a-paint-for-your-portfolio-to-color/ |archive-date=16 June 2013 |url-status=dead }} * 2006 : On 11 July, Goodlass Paint Ltd. name has been changed to Kansai Nerolac Paints Ltd. ==Company overview== Kansai Nerolac Paints has 6 paint manufacturing plants and about 6–7 contract manufacturers. The Nerolac owned plants are at 1. Jainpur, [[Kanpur Dehat]] ([[Uttar Pradesh]]) 2. [[Bawal]] ([[Haryana]]) 3. [[Lote, India|Lote]], Chiplun ([[Maharashtra]]) 4. [[Hosur]] ([[Tamil Nadu]]) 5. Sayakha ([[Gujarat]]) 6. Goindwal ([[Punjab]]) 7. [[Visakhapatnam]] ([[Andhra Pradesh]]) (Upcoming {{cite web|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/kansai-nerolac-sees-month-on-month-improvement-in-auto-coatings-sales/article32667267.ece|title = Kansai Nerolac sees month-on-month improvement in auto coatings sales| date=22 September 2020 }}) Kansai Nerolac Paints Ltd. has entered into many technical collaborations with other industry leaders such as E.I. Du-products.{{cite web |url=http://www.jobstreet.co.in/company/Kansai_Nerolac/aboutus.htm |title=About Kansai Nerolac |access-date=17 April 2013 |archive-date=24 April 2014 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140424095157/http://www.jobstreet.co.in/company/Kansai_Nerolac/aboutus.htm |url-status=dead }} The [[Mumbai]]-based company is the leader in the industrial paints segment with a market share of over 40%.{{cite web |url=http://poweryourtrade.moneycontrol.com/plus/multibagger/multibagger_promo.php?autono=2391 |title=Multi Baggers |publisher=Poweryourtrade.moneycontrol.com |date= |access-date=2022-08-19}} It is the third-largest player in the decorative paints segment with a modest market share of 13%. The Products include- Automotive Coatings, Industrial coatings, Decorative coatings, Protective coatings and Marine Coatings.{{cite web |url=http://www.kansai.co.jp/global_site/corporate_profile/02_4.html |title=Research & Development Stages | Corporate Profile | Kansai Paint Co., LTD. |access-date=23 April 2013 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130403011005/http://www.kansai.co.jp/global_site/corporate_profile/02_4.html |archive-date=3 April 2013 |url-status=dead }} They are also present in [[U.K.]], [[Turkey]], [[United States|U.S.]], [[Canada]], [[Mexico]], [[UAE]]. == Products and services== Technologically innovative products are the company's hallmark. Kansai Nerolac Paint offers differentiated products with a focus on being eco-friendly and healthy.{{cite news| url=http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2012-02-06/news/31030595_1_paints-industry-decorative-segment-kansai-nerolac | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140424100215/http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2012-02-06/news/31030595_1_paints-industry-decorative-segment-kansai-nerolac | url-status=dead | archive-date=24 April 2014 | work=The Times Of India | title=Kansai Nerolac: Despite difficult 3rd quarter,it is well-positioned to grow | date=6 February 2012}} Kansai Nerolac Paint's key products and brands include the following: *'''Decorative Paints''': Interior wall paints, exterior wall paints, Wood surface paints, and Metals surface paints.{{cite web|url=http://www.nerolac.com/high/index.html|title=Nerolac|access-date=22 April 2013|archive-date=19 April 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130419015521/http://www.nerolac.com/high/index.html|url-status=dead}} *'''Automotive Coatings''' :Pre-Treatment Chemicals, Electrodeposition. Intermediate Coats/Primer Surfacers, Topcoats, Clear Coats, Touch Up Paints, Auto Refinishing Products, Heat Resistant Paints, Underbody Paints & PVC Sealants & Rapgard Transit Protection Films. *'''Performance Coatings''': Performance Coating is available for a wide range of products. For household appliances and metal fittings in factories, there is a comprehensive range of general industrial coating systems like P.T. chemicals, [[Primer (paint)|Primer]]s and [[lacquers]], Coil Coat, Heat Resistant Paints & Metal Decoration Coatings. Kansai Nerolac Paints Limited (formerly known as Goodlass Nerolac Paints Ltd) is the largest industrial paint and third largest decorative paint company of India based in Mumbai.
It is a subsidiary of Kansai Paint of Japan. As of 2015, it has the third largest market share with 15.4% in the Indian paint industry. It is engaged in the industrial, automotive and powder coating business. It develops and supplies paint systems used on the finishing lines of electrical components, cycle, material handling equipment, bus bodies, containers and furniture industries.
